subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage accounting architecture and allow promotion-authorized lineage totals to become authoritative after validation?
rationale: Tests establish implementation invariants, but maintainers must choose the permanent accounting authority, rollout threshold, and rollback policy for user-visible cost totals.

options.title: Adopt guarded lineage
options.body: Review the stack in order, require exact-head cache-lifecycle proof, retain legacy as the default, and permit lineage authority only through the explicit promotion gate.

options.title: Keep shadow-only
options.body: Accept discovery and diagnostics while permanently preventing lineage totals from becoming authoritative.

options.title: Defer the architecture
options.body: Retain the merged file-local containment and postpone the cross-file lineage rearchitecture until stronger operational evidence exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded lineage
recommendation.body: Review the stack in order, require exact-head cache-lifecycle proof, retain legacy as the default, and permit lineage authority only through the explicit promotion gate.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current-main predecessor and are the strongest available owner for the repository-level accounting and rollout choice.
